1  JUDGE, KALABURAGI IN LAC NO. 142/2018, SET ASIDE THE  -2-  NC: 2024:KHC-K:9858  MFA No. 201696 of 2023 JUDGMENT AND AWARD IN LAC NO. 142/2018, DATED 11-02-2022, ON THE FILE OF I ADDL. DISTRICT AND SESSIONS JUDGE, KALABURAGI, IN THE INTEREST OF JUSTICE AND EQUITY.
THIS APPEAL, COMING ON FOR ORDERS, THIS DAY,
JUDGMENT WAS DELIVERED THEREIN AS UNDER:
CORAM: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE SACHIN SHANKAR MAGADUM  ORAL JUDGMENT (PER: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE SACHIN SHANKAR MAGADUM)
The present appeal, filed under Section 74(1) of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition,
Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013, challenges the judgment and award dated 11.02.2022 in LAC No.142/2018.
Relying on precedents, including Union of India vs. Popular Construction Co. and State of Kerala vs. NC: 2024:KHC-K:9858 V.R. Kalliyanikutty, the appeal is dismissed as time- barred, without addressing the merits.
opennyai_summary.decision:
However, the appeal is filed after a delay of 341 days beyond the statutory limitation period of 120 days prescribed under Section 74(1) of the Act.
This Court, following the Division Bench ruling in MFA No.102543/2022 dated 23.09.2024, holds that the limitation period under the Act is mandatory and non- extendable.
Parties shall bear their respective costs.
In view of disposal of main appeal, pending applications, if any, stand rejected.
The Court fee paid, if any, shall be refunded in accordance with law.
